title.narrative: Palestinian Youth for Peace

description.narrative: The action aims at strengthen the voice of Palestinian female and male youth to be future leaders of peace building initiatives based on the United Nations resolutions, and to enhance the capacity of youth and local actors (CBOs). The youth will be equipped with knowledge and skills related to a just peace and non-violence approaches and will possibly transfer their knowledge and skills to their peers and to the target groups of their community based organizations.
